campaign: PCRL: correction transfer, genuine refits and a stable method comparison
branch: research/pcrl-correction-transfer-stability-v1 (local only; its history contains private paths)
publication_branch: publication/pcrl-correction-transfer-stability-v1 on https://github.com/Bostesa/PCRL.git (registration receipt 2ad31d2af, freeze receipt d3f28497b, final package recorded in PUBLICATION_RECORD.json)

outcome.classification: a replicated, independently replayed diagnosis and a negative method result (development evidence); no competitive candidate; no useful protection component
outcome.question_A: no: the out-of-fold estimate over-predicts NLL (non-nested cross-fitting the likely source; one-partition check) and its men's-cost error changes sign between partitions; the GUARD estimate is unbiased but as noisy as the slack; no REFIT-routed PAIR or LOC unit is PREDICTION_IMPROVED under the registered scheme (two R1 units SCHEME_DEPENDENT; A5)
outcome.question_B: no method result: NO_RECIPE (all 32 recipes fail G1 on D1); GUARD rules never improve on OLD (close to forced); no nonzero strength keeps the reserve; the correction lowers the declared readers' recovery beyond W (s = 1.0) and CONT (s >= 0.3) only at 14-70 times the R0 slack
outcome.question_C: the old gate passes 19-31% of true-zero income differences under law L1 at two repetitions; H3's income view alone fails it; every required reference fails the reserve; no reserve-qualified point lowers recovery
outcome.adaptive_finding: the witness margin is consistent with a training-size effect (P70 refit; amendment 9); selection at 100% not excluded

roles.statistical reviewer: strength rules, claim ladder, screen rule (RULES.md); screen review; training-size review; question-A bootstrap adjudication (A2); PROTOCOL section 8 adjudication (A5)

roles.reader investigator: reader-grid adapter; screen operating-characteristic study (report and findings saved by the coordinator)
roles.independent verifier: separate-code verification, 269 checks, follow-up on A5 (report saved verbatim by the coordinator)
roles.engineering reviewer: code correctness review, 11 patches before any correction outcome
roles.claims reviewer: statement-by-statement review of the decision documents (report saved verbatim; all edits applied, A7)
